<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Cheer Up, Love! </title>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Pacifico&family=Quicksand:wght@400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
</head>
<body>
    <!-- Floating Stickers -->
    <div class="sticker">🌟</div>
    <div class="sticker">🎈</div>
    <div class="sticker">💖</div>
    <div class="sticker">✨</div>
    <div class="sticker">🌈</div>
<div>
    <div class="container">
        <h1>Feeling Down? 😢</h1>
        <div class="big-smile">😊</div>
<p>        
        <p class="message">
            Don't worry! Life gets better! 
            <br>Click the stickers to cheer up you up! ✨
        </p>
<div>
        <div class="buttons">
            <button class="btn btn-yes" onclick="showResponse('yes')">
                Yes! I'm cheering up! 🎉
            </button>
            <button class="btn btn-no" onclick="showResponse('no')">
                Still sad 😔
            </button>
        </div>
<div>
        <div class="song-player">
            <h3>🎵 Cheer Up Song 🎵</h3>
            <button class="play-btn" onclick="playCheerSong()">Play Cheer Up Song!</button>
            <audio id="cheerSong" loop>
                <source src="data:audio/wav;base64,    "components": "@/components",
    "utils": "@/lib/utils",
    "ui": "@/components/ui",
    "lib": "@/lib",
    "hooks": "@/hooks"
  },
  "iconLibrary": "lucide"
}

</html>
